meta.name: lab-retro
meta.description: Final retrospective and self-assessment for participants of Claude Code Lab. Runs four sequential interactive parts — progress audit, best prompt, monthly plan, and feedback — using AskUserQuestion. Triggers on "/lab-retro", "lab retrospective", "claude code lab final", or after completing the 6-week Claude Code Lab cohort.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会引导你依次完成四个互动环节：检查技能进步、存下你最得意的提示词、制定一个月行动计划、提交对训练营的反馈。所有内容都保存在当前文件夹的 lab-retro-output/ 里。
howto.when: 当你说出“/lab-retro”、“lab retrospective”等关键词，或完成6周Claude Code Lab训练营后，Claude就会启动这个回顾流程。
